description:
Search for known clinical-stage drugs with target-disease relationships.
Data: Open Targets Platform 25.09 · table known_drug — one record = one (drug, target, disease) clinical-precedence record per phase and trial status.
Key: drugId, targetId, diseaseId, phase, status (phase and status may be null).
Arguments: target_id accepts ensembl gene or hgnc symbol (resolved; unknown -> error); disease_id accepts ot disease or disease name (resolved; unknown -> error).
Results: ranked by phase desc (verified by the harness); `_vbt.total` counts all matches; `_vbt.grains.drug` counts drugs; `_vbt.grains.parent_drug` counts parent_drugs; `_vbt.grains.indication` counts indications; `_vbt.grains.triple` counts triples.
Rows with unknown phase are excluded and counted in `_vbt.excluded_unknown`.
Empty vs not found: unknown identifiers are errors; an empty result is citable only as an absence. ChEMBL-curated drug-target-indication precedence only; absence means 'no curated drug', not 'undruggable'.
include_descendants=true with disease_id also returns the drugs of every descendant disease term; each row names its own disease.

schema.description: Pass at least one of: target_id, disease_id.

disease_id.description: Accepts ot_disease, disease_name; resolved to one ot_disease (unknown values are errors, never empty results).

min_phase.description: Keeps rows with phase >= this value; unknown values never pass. Defaults to 0; pass 0 for no restriction (null is not accepted).

target_id.description: Accepts ensembl_gene, hgnc_symbol; resolved to one ensembl_gene (unknown values are errors, never empty results).
